rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a poor-quality early blastocyst and intact zona, but it incorrectly states the blastocoel is <50% despite the provided Gardner 1 definition here being at least half the embryo, and it adds somewhat speculative detail about lineage appearance.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, endometrium, uterine factor, prior ectopic history, and semen parameters with embryo quality reasonably well, though some inferences are stronger than the available data support.

The overall logic is understandable, but there are notable overstatements such as calling the embryo quality 'catastrophic' and implying severe aneuploidy/arrest from morphology alone; the response is also incomplete/truncated before probability and recommendations.

Use of Gardner grading concepts is broadly aligned, but the expansion-stage description conflicts with the case-provided definition, and some conclusions exceed what morphology alone can establish under standard IVF guidance.
The visible portion offers limited practical next steps and is truncated before clear transfer recommendations or future cycle planning, so clinician usefulness is modest.
